description: Defines a template class for calculating moving averages with a sliding window, including specializations for integral types and double precision.

classes.name: base_moving_average
classes.description: A base class implementing sliding window storage and basic operations for moving averages.

classes.name: moving_averager
classes.description: Template class for calculating moving averages of integral types, with specialization for double type.

classes.name: moving_averager<double>
classes.description: Specialization of moving_averager for double, addressing precision issues.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new sample to the moving average, updating the sum accordingly.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Returns the current moving average value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the moving average and clears stored samples.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the sliding window for the moving average.
